dialogues.jp:
教室や廊下をだらだらと歩きつつ、帰り道が空
いてから帰宅する。
dialogues.en:
I trudge along through the classroom and the hallway until
my route home gets less crowded.
dialogues.text:
I trudge along through the classroom and the hallway until
my route home gets less crowded.

dialogues.jp: 「……そうか」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp: 人気のない校門で振り返る。
dialogues.en: I turn back at the deserted school gate.
dialogues.text: I turn back at the deserted school gate.

dialogues.jp:
よく考えれば、１日まともに学園にいなくては
ならなかった日は、今日で最後だったか。
dialogues.en:
When you think about it, today's the last day that I have to
stay all day at school.
dialogues.text:
When you think about it, today's the last day that I have to
stay all day at school.

dialogues.jp: 付属を卒業して本校へ。
dialogues.en:
I'll attend the main school after graduating from this side
school.
dialogues.text:
I'll attend the main school after graduating from this side
school.

dialogues.jp: なにも変わることはない。
dialogues.en: It won't change anything.
dialogues.text: It won't change anything.

dialogues.jp: 日常の繰り返し。
dialogues.en: It's just the same repetition of the usual day.
dialogues.text: It's just the same repetition of the usual day.

dialogues.jp:
それなのに、どうしてか今日の下校の空気はい
つもと違う気がするな。
dialogues.en:
But when home time came today, I felt a different atmosphere
somehow.
dialogues.text:
But when home time came today, I felt a different atmosphere
somehow.

dialogues.jp: 「……どうなんだろうな」
dialogues.en: "Why is that?"
dialogues.text: "Why is that?"

dialogues.jp:
難しいことは、分からないとかの前に考えたく
もない。
dialogues.en: I don't want to think about it, no matter what it is.
dialogues.text: I don't want to think about it, no matter what it is.

dialogues.jp: 「とりあえず最大の問題は……」
dialogues.en: "Let's just say the biggest problem is..."
dialogues.text: "Let's just say the biggest problem is..."

dialogues.jp: ずっしりと肩にくる鞄を担ぎなおす。
dialogues.en: I lift my heavy bag onto my shoulder.
dialogues.text: I lift my heavy bag onto my shoulder.

dialogues.jp:
中身は今まで残していた教科書やノートだが、
１個１個が軽くても、みんなの力を合わせれば
俺をだるくすることも出来るのだ。
dialogues.en:
I know that each of the textbooks and notebooks I keep
inside it are light individually, but it can be heavy enough
to make me tired if you put them together.
dialogues.text:
I know that each of the textbooks and notebooks I keep
inside it are light individually, but it can be heavy enough
to make me tired if you put them together.

dialogues.jp: 「ふっ……授業中だけの敵だと思ったんだがな」
dialogues.en: "Huh, and I thought they were only my enemy in class."
dialogues.text: "Huh, and I thought they were only my enemy in class."

dialogues.jp:
自分でも不毛だとは思いつつ呟きながら、てく
てくと学園に背をむけた。
dialogues.en:
I turn around and start to walk away from school, mumbling
about the futility of it all.
dialogues.text:
I turn around and start to walk away from school, mumbling
about the futility of it all.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おに〜ちゃ〜ん！」
dialogues.en: "Onii~cha~n!"
dialogues.text: "Onii~cha~n!"

dialogues.jp:
今回は分かりやすく、道のど真中で元から学園
のほうを向いたさくらがいた。
dialogues.en:
This time, I see Sakura in the middle of the street, walking
toward the school.
dialogues.text:
This time, I see Sakura in the middle of the street, walking
toward the school.

dialogues.en: "Hey."
dialogues.text: "Hey."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「赤い番傘をさして歩いていると最高なのに」
dialogues.en:
"It could be a great scene if you put up a red umbrella
there."
dialogues.text:
"It could be a great scene if you put up a red umbrella
there."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……任侠映画じゃないっての」
dialogues.en: "You're into your samurai movies too much."
dialogues.text: "You're into your samurai movies too much."

dialogues.jp:
目の前まで来て、挨拶に悩んでポンと手を頭に
のせてかき回す。
dialogues.en:
When she walks right up in front of me, I ruffle her hair
instead of greeting her.
dialogues.text:
When she walks right up in front of me, I ruffle her hair
instead of greeting her.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃにゃ♪」
dialogues.en: "Purrrr!"
dialogues.text: "Purrrr!"

dialogues.jp:
俺の手に頬をこすりつけてさくらが目を細める。
本当にただの猫だな。
dialogues.en:
She narrows her eyes and rubs her cheeks against my hand.
She really acts like a cat.
dialogues.text:
She narrows her eyes and rubs her cheeks against my hand.
She really acts like a cat.

dialogues.jp:
「なんか聞き飽きてきた気もするが、今日はコ
　コでなにやってるんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"I don't remember how many times I've asked you the same
thing like what you're doing here."
dialogues.text:
"I don't remember how many times I've asked you the same
thing like what you're doing here."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「なにもしてないよぉ。桜と学園を見てただけ
　だよぉ」
dialogues.en:
"Nothing. I was just watching cherry blossoms and the
school."
dialogues.text:
"Nothing. I was just watching cherry blossoms and the
school."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「学園？」
dialogues.en: "School?"
dialogues.text: "School?"

dialogues.jp: さくらの視線を追うように振り返る。
dialogues.en: I turn around, following Sakura's line of sight.
dialogues.text: I turn around, following Sakura's line of sight.

dialogues.jp:
そこには、いつもの登校風景があるだけだが、
こうやってじっくりと見たことはなかったか。
dialogues.en:
There is nothing there but the usual sight from the walk
home, but I've never looked at it carefully until now.
dialogues.text:
There is nothing there but the usual sight from the walk
home, but I've never looked at it carefully until now.

dialogues.jp: 「楽しいか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you enjoy it?"
dialogues.text: "Do you enjoy it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「別に面白くはないよ」
dialogues.en: "Nothing really to enjoy."
dialogues.text: "Nothing really to enjoy."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、なんでだ」
dialogues.en: "Then why are you here?"
dialogues.text: "Then why are you here?"

dialogues.jp: 視線をさくらに戻す。
dialogues.en: I look at Sakura again.
dialogues.text: I look at Sakura again.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「もぅ卒業なんだなぁ、って思って」
dialogues.en: "I was thinking that we'll graduate from this school soon."
dialogues.text: "I was thinking that we'll graduate from this school soon."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「またひとつ階段を登るんだよ」
dialogues.en: "We'll go up one more step."
dialogues.text: "We'll go up one more step."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「多分、その１歩では上を見上げても、下を振
　り返っても景色は変わらないと思う」
dialogues.en:
"I don't think one step will make any scenery change whether
you look up or look down."
dialogues.text:
"I don't think one step will make any scenery change whether
you look up or look down."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「でも、そうやって１歩１歩進むうちに、いつ
　のまにか高いところまで行っちゃうんだ。そ
　れで、今この時間を懐かしく思うんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"But eventually, you'll reach the highest point by taking
one step after another. That's why this moment feels very
special to me."
dialogues.text:
"But eventually, you'll reach the highest point by taking
one step after another. That's why this moment feels very
special to me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……そんなもんかな」
dialogues.en: "Is that right?"
dialogues.text: "Is that right?"

dialogues.jp:
こんな気恥ずかしいようなことを、真顔で言え
るさくらがすごい。
dialogues.en:
I am amazed at Sakura, who can talk about such embarrassing
stuff so seriously.
dialogues.text:
I am amazed at Sakura, who can talk about such embarrassing
stuff so seriously.

dialogues.jp:
いや、こいつはいつも何を喋っていても本気な
んだな。
dialogues.en: I guess she means whatever she says.
dialogues.text: I guess she means whatever she says.

dialogues.jp: 「……なぁ、俺のこと好きか？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, do you like me?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, do you like me?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm?"

dialogues.jp: どんぐり眼が俺を見上げる。
dialogues.en: Her big, round eyes glance up at me.
dialogues.text: Her big, round eyes glance up at me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「もちろん。大、大、大好きだよ♪」
dialogues.en: "Of course. I like you a lot!"
dialogues.text: "Of course. I like you a lot!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「本当はきっかり１年間お兄ちゃんと通いたかっ
　たよ。にゃはははは♪」
dialogues.en:
"I wish I could have studied with you in this school for
whole one year. Hahahaha..."
dialogues.text:
"I wish I could have studied with you in this school for
whole one year. Hahahaha..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「それは……騒がしかっただろうな」
dialogues.en: "It could have been a very noisy year."
dialogues.text: "It could have been a very noisy year."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ！？」
dialogues.en: "Hmmm!?"
dialogues.text: "Hmmm!?"

dialogues.jp: へへへ、と笑いながらさくらの頭をまたなでる。
dialogues.en: I stroke her head again, laughing bashfully.
dialogues.text: I stroke her head again, laughing bashfully.

dialogues.jp: 「どっか遊びに行くか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want to go somewhere?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want to go somewhere?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「わっ、ホント？」
dialogues.en: "Whoa, really?"
dialogues.text: "Whoa, really?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「金のかからないところな」
dialogues.en: "Somewhere cheap."
dialogues.text: "Somewhere cheap."

dialogues.jp: 舞い散る桜を見上げながら。
dialogues.en: I look up at the cherry blossoms flying high.
dialogues.text: I look up at the cherry blossoms flying high.

dialogues.jp:
こんな登下校も今日からしばらくないことを考
えれば、少しくらい騒がしいのを耳に残してお
いてもいいと思った。
dialogues.en:
I don't mind if it gets boisterous when I think there will
be no more going-home time for a while.
dialogues.text:
I don't mind if it gets boisterous when I think there will
be no more going-home time for a while.

dialogues.jp: ◆振り向いて◆
dialogues.en: ◆Turn around◆
dialogues.text: ◆Turn around◆

dialogues.jp:
帰り道、桜並木で校舎を見上げるさくらを見つ
けた。どうやら、卒業に物思いを馳せているら
しい。
dialogues.en:
On the way home, I saw Sakura looking up at the school
building in the row of cherry blossom trees. She said she
was thinking of the coming graduation.
dialogues.text:
On the way home, I saw Sakura looking up at the school
building in the row of cherry blossom trees. She said she
was thinking of the coming graduation.

dialogues.jp:
そして、俺と１年間まるごと一緒に通いたかっ
た――なんて笑顔を浮かべられてしまうのだっ
た。
dialogues.en:
And she smiled and said she wished she could've been at
school together with me for the whole year.
dialogues.text:
And she smiled and said she wished she could've been at
school together with me for the whole year.
